records.text_en: From al-Haytham, from Jābir ibn al-Aswad or al-Aswad ibn Jābir, from his father ؓ: That two men prayed Ẓuhr in their houses in the time of the Prophet ﷺ thinking that the people had already prayed. Then they came to the mosque, and the Messenger of God ﷺ was in prayer, so they sat in a corner of the mosque, thinking that prayer was not permissible for them. When the Messenger of God ﷺ finished and saw them, he sent for them, and they were brought, their shoulder-muscles trembling for fear that there be something about their matter. He asked them and they told him the story. He said: "If you two did that, pray with the people, and make the first the obligatory one." It was said: This ḥadīth has been narrated by a group from Abū Ḥanīfa ؓ, who said: from al-Haytham, raising it to the Prophet ﷺ.
records.text_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ أَوِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ صَلَّيَا الظُّهْرَ فِي بُيُوتِهِمَا عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُمَا يَرَيَانِ أَنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ صَلُّوا، ثُمَّ أَتَيَا الْمَسْجِدَ، فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، فَقَعَدَا نَاحِيَةً مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَهُمَا يَرَيَانِ أَنَّ الصَّلَاةَ لَا تَحِلُّ لَهُمَا، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَرَآهُمَا أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِمَا، فَجِيءَ بِهِمَا، وَفَرَايِصُهُمَا تَرْتَعِدُ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي أَمْرِهِمَا شَيْءٌ، فَسَأَلَهُمَا، فَأَخْبَرَاهُ الْخَبَرَ، فَقَالَ: «إذَا فَعَلْتُمَا ذَلِكَ، فَصَلِّيَا مَعَ النَّاسِ، وَاجْعَلَا الْأُولَى هِيَ الْفَرْضَ»، قِيلَ: قَدْ رُوِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ عَنْ جَمَاعَةٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالُوا: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ يَرْفَعُهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ

records.text_en: From Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd, from ʿAmra, from ʿĀʾisha ؓ, who said: They used to go to Friday prayer having sweated and being smeared with mud, so it was said to them: "Whoever goes to Friday prayer, let him wash." In a narration: The people were cultivators of their land, and they would go with sweat and dust mixed on them, so the Messenger of God ﷺ said to them: "When you attend Friday prayer, wash."
records.text_ar: عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ: كَانُوا يَرُوحُونَ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ، وَقَدْ عَرَقُوا وَتَلَطَّخُوا بِالطِّينِ، فَقِيلَ لَهُمْ: «مَنْ رَاحَ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ، فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: كَانَ النَّاسُ عُمَّارَ أَرْضِهِمْ، وَكَانُوا يَرُوحُونَ يُخَالِطُهُمُ الْعَرَقُ وَالتُّرَابُ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إذَا حَضَرْتُمُ الْجُمُعَةَ، فَاغْتَسِلُوا»

matn.arabic: كَانُوا يَرُوحُونَ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ، وَقَدْ عَرَقُوا وَتَلَطَّخُوا بِالطِّينِ، فَقِيلَ لَهُمْ: «مَنْ رَاحَ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ، فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: كَانَ النَّاسُ عُمَّارَ أَرْضِهِمْ، وَكَانُوا يَرُوحُونَ يُخَالِطُهُمُ الْعَرَقُ وَالتُّرَابُ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إذَا حَضَرْتُمُ الْجُمُعَةَ، فَاغْتَسِلُوا»

records.text_en: And Manṣūr and Muḥammad ibn Bishr, all of them, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar ؓ: That the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Washing on Friday is upon whoever comes to Friday prayer."

records.text_en: From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, that a man narrated to him that he asked ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd ؓ, "about the sermon of the Prophet ﷺ, on Friday. He said to him: 'Do you not recite Sūrat al-Jumuʿa?' He said: 'Yes, but I do not know.' He said: So he recited to him: {And when they see trade or amusement, they disperse to it and leave you standing} [Sūrat al-Jumuʿa: 11]."
records.text_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ "عَنْ خُطْبَةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: أَمَا تَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ؟ قَالَ: بَلَى، وَلَكِنْ لَا أَعْلَمُ، قَالَ: فَقَرَأَ عَلَيْهِ: {وَإِذَا رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا انْفَضُّوا إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَائِمًا} [الجمعة: 11]"

records.text_en: From al-Haytham, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Hurayra ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Whoever dies on Friday is protected from the punishment of the grave."
records.text_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ مَاتَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وُقِيَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ»

records.text_en: From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, [from] one who heard Umm ʿAṭiyya say: "Women were given permission to go out to the two Eids, so much so that two virgin girls would go out in a single garment, so much so that the menstruating woman would go out and sit at the edge of the people; they supplicate and do not pray."

records.text_en:
From ʿAbd al-Karīm, from Umm ʿAṭiyya, who said: "He used to permit going out to the two Eids, of al-Fiṭr and al-Aḍḥā." In a narration, she said: "The menstruating woman would go out and sit at the edge of the women and supplicate at the two Eids."

In a narration, she said: The Messenger of God ﷺ commanded us "to bring out, on the Day of Sacrifice and the Day of Fiṭr, the women in seclusion and the menstruating women; as for the menstruating women, they keep apart from the prayer and witness the good and the supplication of the Muslims."

A woman said: "O Messenger of God, what if one of us has no jilbāb?" He said: "Let her sister clothe her from her jilbāb."
records.text_ar:
عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ: «كَانَ يُرَخِّصُ فِي الْخُرُوجِ إِلَى الْعِيدَيْنِ مِنَ الْفِطْرِ وَالْأَضْحَى»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، قَالَتْ: «إنْ كَانَ الطَّامِثُ تَخْرُجُ، فَتَجْلِسُ فِي عُرْضِ النِّسَاءِ، فَتَدْعُو فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، قَالَتْ: أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «أَنْ نُخْرِجَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، وَيَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ ذَوَاتِ الْخُدُورِ وَالْحُيَّضَ، فَأَمَّا الْحُيَّضُ، فَيَعْتَزِلْنَ الصَّلَاةَ وَيَشْهَدْنَ الْخَيْرَ وَدَعْوَةَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ».

records.text_en: From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿAlqama, from ʿAbd Allāh ؓ: That he came and it was said [to him]: "ʿUthmān prayed four at Minā." He said: "Indeed to God we belong, and indeed to Him we return. 'I prayed with the Messenger of God ﷺ two rakʿas, and with Abū Bakr ؓ two rakʿas, and with ʿUmar ؓ two rakʿas; then I attended the prayer with ʿUthmān and prayed four rakʿas with him.'" It was said to him: "You said 'to God we belong and to Him we return,' you said what you said, then you prayed four?" He said: "The caliphate." Then he said: "And he was the first to complete it as four at Minā."

records.text_en:

matn.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا فَصْلَ فِي الْوِتْرِ»

records.text_en: From ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar ؓ, who said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "Witr at the beginning of the night is the displeasure of Satan, and eating the pre-dawn meal is the pleasure of the Merciful."
records.text_ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ: «الْوِتْرُ أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ مَسْخَطَةُ الشَّيْطَانِ، وَأَكْلُ السَّحُورِ مَرْضَاةُ الرَّحْمَنِ»

isnad.english: From ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar ؓ, who said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say:
isnad.arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ:

matn.english: "Witr at the beginning of the night is the displeasure of Satan, and eating the pre-dawn meal is the pleasure of the Merciful."
matn.arabic: «الْوِتْرُ أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ مَسْخَطَةُ الشَّيْطَانِ، وَأَكْلُ السَّحُورِ مَرْضَاةُ الرَّحْمَنِ»

records.text_en: From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Jadalī, from Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī ؓ, who said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ prayed witr at the beginning of the night, its middle and its end, so that it be broad for the Muslims; whichever of that they adopt is right, except that whoever hopes to stand at night [in prayer], let him make his witr at the end of the night, for that is better." In a narration: from Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Jadalī, from ʿUqba ibn ʿĀmir and Abū Mūsā ؓ, that they said: The Messenger of God ﷺ, "would pray witr sometimes at the beginning of the night, its middle and its end, so that it be a latitude for the Muslims."
records.text_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَدَلِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: "أَوْتَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ، وَأَوْسَطَهُ، وَآخِرَهُ، لِكَيْ يَكُونَ وَاسِعًا عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ، أَيَّ: ذَلِكَ أَخَذُوا بِهِ كَانَ صَوَابًا، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ مَنْ طَمِعَ لِقِيَامِ اللَّيْلِ، فَلْيَجْعَلْ وِتْرَهُ فِي آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ، فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ أَفْضَلُ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَدَلِيِّ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، وَأَبِي مُوسَى رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «يُوتِرُ أَحْيَانًا أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ، وَأَوْسَطَهُ، وَآخِرَهُ، لِيَكُونَ سَعَةً لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ»

records.text_en:
From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from Abū Wāʾil, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd ؓ: That when he came from the land of Abyssinia, he greeted the Messenger of God ﷺ, while he was praying, and he did not return the greeting. When the Messenger of God ﷺ finished, Ibn Masʿūd said: "I seek refuge in God from the displeasure of God's favor." He ﷺ said: "And what is that?!" He said: "I greeted you and you did not return my greeting." He said: "In prayer there is indeed preoccupation."

"So we did not return the greeting to anyone from that day."
records.text_ar:
عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَدِمَ مِنْ أَرْضِ الْحَبَشَةِ سَلَّمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ سَخَطِ نِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: وَمَا ذَاكَ؟! قَالَ: سَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْكَ، فَلَمْ تَرُدَّ عَلَيَّ، قَالَ: «إِنَّ فِي الصَّلَاةِ لَشُغْلًا».

فَلَمْ نَرُدَّ السَّلَامَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ يَوْمِئِذٍ

أَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَدِمَ مِنْ أَرْضِ الْحَبَشَةِ سَلَّمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ سَخَطِ نِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: وَمَا ذَاكَ؟! قَالَ: سَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْكَ، فَلَمْ تَرُدَّ عَلَيَّ، قَالَ: «إِنَّ فِي الصَّلَاةِ لَشُغْلًا».

isnad.english: From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from Abū Wāʾil, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd ؓ:
isnad.arabic: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ:

matn.english:
That when he came from the land of Abyssinia, he greeted the Messenger of God ﷺ, while he was praying, and he did not return the greeting. When the Messenger of God ﷺ finished, Ibn Masʿūd said: "I seek refuge in God from the displeasure of God's favor." He ﷺ said: "And what is that?!" He said: "I greeted you and you did not return my greeting." He said: "In prayer there is indeed preoccupation."

"So we did not return the greeting to anyone from that day."
matn.arabic:
أَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَدِمَ مِنْ أَرْضِ الْحَبَشَةِ سَلَّمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ سَخَطِ نِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: وَمَا ذَاكَ؟! قَالَ: سَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْكَ، فَلَمْ تَرُدَّ عَلَيَّ، قَالَ: «إِنَّ فِي الصَّلَاةِ لَشُغْلًا».

records.text_en: From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad ibn Yazīd, that he asked ʿĀʾisha about what cuts the prayer. She said: "O people of Iraq, you claim that the donkey, the woman, the dog and the cat cut the prayer; you have coupled us with them. Ward off as much as you can. 'The Prophet ﷺ used to pray while I slept at his side, wearing a garment, its edge on me.'"
records.text_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ عَمَّا يَقْطَعُ الصَّلَاةَ، فَقَالَتْ: يَا أَهْلَ الْعِرَاقِ، تَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ الْحِمَارَ وَالْمَرْأَةَ وَالْكَلْبَ وَالسِّنَّوْرُ يَقْطَعُونَ الصَّلَاةَ، قَرَنْتُمُونَا بِهِمْ، ادْرَأْ مَا اسْتَطَعْتَ، «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُصَلِّي وَأَنَا نَائِمَةٌ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، عَلَيْهِ ثَوْبٌ جَانِبُهُ عَلَيَّ»

records.text_en:
From ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib, from his father, from Ibn ʿAmr, who said: The sun was eclipsed on the day Ibrāhīm, the son of the Messenger of God ﷺ died, and the people said: "The sun was eclipsed for the death of Ibrāhīm." The Prophet ﷺ stood a long standing until they thought he would not bow. Then he bowed, and his bowing was equal to his standing; then he raised his head, and his standing was equal to his bowing; then he prostrated equal to his standing, and his sitting between the two prostrations was equal to his prostration; then he prostrated equal to his sitting. Then he prayed the second rakʿa and did likewise, until, when it was the prostration of it, he wept, and his weeping intensified, and we heard him saying: "Did You not promise me that You would not punish them while I am among them?" Then he sat and recited the tashahhud, then turned and faced them, and said: "The sun and the moon are two signs among the signs of God, with which God Almighty frightens His servants; they are not eclipsed for the death of anyone nor for his life. So when it is thus, hold to prayer. I saw myself brought near to Paradise so that, had I wished to take a branch from the branches of its trees, I would have done so; and I saw myself brought near to the Fire so that I began to guard myself; and I saw in it the thief of the Messenger of God ﷺ." records.text_en:
From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿAlqama, from ʿAbd Allāh ؓ, who said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ used to teach us istikhāra in a matter as he taught us a sūra of the Qurʾān." In a narration, he said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "When one of you intends a matter, let him perform ablution and pray two rakʿas other than the obligatory prayer, then let him say: O God, I seek Your choice by Your knowledge, and I seek ability by Your power, and I ask You of Your bounty; for You know and I do not know, You are able and I am not able, and You are the Knower of the unseen.

O God, if this matter is good for me in my livelihood and good for me in the outcome of my affair, then make it easy for me and bless me in it."

And he added in a narration: "And if it is other than that, decree for me the good wherever it may be, then make me content with it."

عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُعَلِّمُنَا الِاسْتِخَارَةِ فِي الْأَمْرِ كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "إذَا أَرَادَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَمْرًا، فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ، وَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ الْفَرِيضَةِ، ثُمَّ لِيَقُلِ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَاسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَتَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ.

records.text_en:
From al-Ḥārith, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Umm Hāniʾ ؓ: "That the Prophet ﷺ, on the day he conquered Mecca, laid aside his armor, and called for water and poured it over it, then called for a single garment and prayed in it." He added in a narration: "wrapped over the shoulders."

In a narration: That the Prophet ﷺ, "laid aside his armor on the day of the conquest of Mecca, then called for water. He said: It was brought in a bowl with bread-dough in it; he screened himself with a garment and washed, then called for a garment and wrapped himself with it over the shoulders, then prayed two rakʿas."

Abū Ḥanīfa ؓ said: "And it is the Ḍuḥā."

In a narration: That the Prophet ﷺ laid aside his armor on the day of the conquest of Mecca and called for water; it was brought in a bowl with a trace of dough in it, and he washed, and prayed four, or two rakʿas, in a single garment, wrapped over the shoulders.
records.text_ar:
عَنِ الْحَرْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ فَتَحَ مَكَّةَ وَضَعَ لَأْمَتَهُ، وَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَصَبَّهُ عَلَيْهَا، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ فَصَلَّى فِيهِ»، زَادَ فِي رِوَايَةٍ: «مُتَوَشِّحًا».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "وَضَعَ لَأْمَتَهُ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ، قَالَ: فَأَتَى بِهِ فِي جَفْنَةٍ فِيهَا خُبْزُ الْعَجِينِ، فَاسْتَتَرَ بِثَوْبٍ فَاغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِثَوْبٍ فَتَوَشَّحَ بِهِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ".

قَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: وَهِيَ الضُّحَى.

«أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ فَتَحَ مَكَّةَ وَضَعَ لَأْمَتَهُ، وَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَصَبَّهُ عَلَيْهَا، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ فَصَلَّى فِيهِ»، زَادَ فِي رِوَايَةٍ: «مُتَوَشِّحًا».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "وَضَعَ لَأْمَتَهُ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ، قَالَ: فَأَتَى بِهِ فِي جَفْنَةٍ فِيهَا خُبْزُ الْعَجِينِ، فَاسْتَتَرَ بِثَوْبٍ فَاغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِثَوْبٍ فَتَوَشَّحَ بِهِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ".

قَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: وَهِيَ الضُّحَى.

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: وَضَعَ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ لَأْمَتَهُ، وَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ، فَأَتَى فِي جَفْنَةٍ فِيهَا أَثَرُ عَجِينٍ فَاغْتَسَلَ، وَصَلَّى أَرْبَعًا، أَوْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ، مُتَوَشِّحًا"

records.text_en: From a man, from ʿĀʾisha ؓ: "That the Prophet ﷺ, when the month of Ramadan came, would stand [in prayer] and sleep; and when the last ten came, he would tighten his waist-wrapper and revive the night."

records.text_en:
From ʿAlqama, from Ibn al-Aqmar, from Ḥumrān, who said: I never met Ibn ʿUmar but that the closest of people in seating was Ḥumrān. One day he said: "O Ḥumrān, I do not see you attending us except that you want good for yourself?" He said: "Yes, O Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān." He said: "As for two, I forbid you from them; as for one, I command you with it, for I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ command it." He said: "What are these three qualities, O Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān?" He said: "Do not die while you owe a debt, except a debt for which you leave repayment; and do not recite a verse to be heard of, for the one who does that will be made to be heard of on the Day of Resurrection, as you made it heard, as retribution — and your Lord wrongs no one.

And as for that which I command you, as the Messenger of God ﷺ commanded me: the two rakʿas of dawn, do not leave them, for in them are the things greatly desired."
records.text_ar:
عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ، عَنْ حُمْرَانَ، قَالَ: مَا أَلْقَى ابْنَ عُمَرَ قَطُّ إِلَّا وَأَقْرَبُ النَّاسِ مَجْلِسًا حُمْرَانُ، فَقَالَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ: يَا حُمْرَانُ، أَلَا أَرَاكَ تُوَاظِبُنَا إِلَّا وَأَنْتَ تُرِيدُ لِنَفْسِكَ خَيْرًا؟ فَقَالَ: أَجَلْ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: أَمَّا اثْنَتَانِ، فَإِنِّي أَنْهَاكَ عَنْهُمَا، أَمَّا وَاحِدَةٌ، فَإِنِّي آمُرُكَ بِهَا، فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَأْمُرُ بِهَا، قَالَ: مَا هِيَ تِلْكَ الْخِصَالُ الثَّلَاثَةُ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ؟ قَالَ: «لَا تَمُوتَنَّ وَعَلَيْكَ دَيْنٌ إِلَّا دَيْنًا تَدَعُ لَهُ وَفَاءً، وَلَا تَسَّمَّعَنَّ مِنْ تِلَاوَةِ آيَةٍ، فَإِنَّهُ يَسَّمَّعُ بِكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَمَا سَمَّعْتَ بِهِ قِصَاصًا، وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًا.

وَأَمَّا الَّذِي آمُرَكَ كَمَا أَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَرَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ لَا تَدَعْهُمَا، فَإِنَّ فِيهِمَا الرَّغَائِبَ»

matn.english: "Whoever prays four rakʿas after ʿishāʾ before leaving the mosque, they equal the like of them on the Night of Qadr."

records.text_en:
From Muḥārib, from Ibn ʿUmar ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Whoever prays four after ʿishāʾ, not separating between them with salām, reciting in the first: the Opening of the Book and 'The Revelation' [al-Sajda]; in the second rakʿa: the Opening of the Book and Ḥā-Mīm 'The Smoke'; and in the third rakʿa: 'Blessed is He' [al-Mulk], it is written for him as for one who stood the Night of Qadr, and he is granted intercession for all the members of his household for whom the Fire had become due, and is protected from the punishment of the grave."

And it was narrated as mawqūf [a statement of the Companion] from Ibn ʿUmar ؓ.
records.text_ar:
عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "مَنْ صَلَّى أَرْبَعًا بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ، لَا يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُنَّ بِتَسْلِيمٍ، يَقْرَأُ فِي الْأُولَى: بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ، وَتَنْزِيلٌ السَّجْدَةُ، وَفِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ: بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَحم الدُّخَانُ، وَفِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّالِثَةِ: بِتَبَارَكَ الْمَلِكُ، كُتِبَ لَهُ كَمَنْ قَامَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ، وَشُفِّعَ فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ كُلِّهِمْ مِمَّنْ وَجَبَتْ لَهُ النَّارُ، وَأُجِيرَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ".

وَرَوَى مَوْقُوفًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا

records.text_en: From Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar ؓ, who said: I asked Bilāl: Where did the Messenger of God ﷺ pray in the Kaʿba? And how much did he pray? He said: "He prayed two rakʿas near the two pillars that are next to the door of the Kaʿba, and the House at that time stood on six pillars."
records.text_ar: عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ بِلَالًا، أَيْنَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْكَعْبَةِ؟ وَكَمْ صَلَّى؟ قَالَ: «صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِمَّا يَلِي الْعَمُودَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ تَلِيَانِ بَابَ الْكَعْبَةِ، وَالْبَيْتُ إذَ ذَاكَ عَلَى سِتَّةِ أَعْمِدَةٍ»

records.text_en:
From Ḥammād, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿUmar ؓ: That a man asked him about the prayer of the Prophet ﷺ, in the Kaʿba on the day he entered it.

He said: "He prayed four rakʿas in the Kaʿba." He said to him: "Show me the place where he prayed." He said: "So he sent his son with him; then he went under the pillar opposite the trunk." In a narration: That Ibn ʿUmar ؓ said: "The Prophet ﷺ prayed four rakʿas in the Kaʿba.

I said to him: 'Show me the place where he prayed,' so he sent his son with him, and he showed me the middle pillar under the trunk."
records.text_ar:
عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَهُ عَنْ صَلَاةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْكَعْبَةِ يَوْمَ دَخَلَهَا.

فَقَالَ: "صَلَّى فِي الْكَعْبَةِ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: أَرِنِي الْمَكَانَ الَّذِي صَلَّى فِيهِ، قَالَ: فَبَعَثَ مَعَهُ ابْنَهُ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ تَحْتَ الأُسْطُوَانَةِ بِحِيَالِ الْجِذْعَةِ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ: "صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْكَعْبَةِ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ.

قُلْتُ لَهُ: أَرِنِي الْمَكَانَ الَّذِي صَلَّى فِيهِ، فَبَعَثَ مَعَهُ ابْنَهُ، فَأَرَانِي الْأُسْطُوَانَةَ الْوُسْطَى تَحْتَ الْجِذْعَةِ"

records.text_en: From Sulaymān ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Dimashqī, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Qushayrī, from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "When a servant dies, and God knows evil from him, while people speak well of him, God Almighty says to His angels: I have accepted the testimony of My servants concerning My servant, and I have forgiven [what is in] My knowledge."
records.text_ar: عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدّمَشْقِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقُشَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيد، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "إِذَا مَاتَ الْعَبْدُ، وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ شَرًّا، وَيَقُولُ النَّاسُ فِي حَقِّهِ خَيْرًا، قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لِمَلَائِكَتِهِ: قَدْ قَبِلْتُ شَهَادَةَ عِبَادِي عَلَى عَبْدِي، وَغَفَرْتُ عِلْمِي"
records.isnad_en: From Sulaymān ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Dimashqī, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Qushayrī, from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: "When a servant dies, and God knows evil from him, while people speak well of him, God Almighty says to His angels: I have accepted the testimony of My servants concerning My servant, and I have forgiven [what is in] My knowledge."

records.text_en: From ʿAlī ibn al-Aqmar, from Abū ʿAṭiyya al-Wādiʿī: "That the Messenger of God ﷺ went out in a funeral procession and saw a woman, so he ordered that she be driven off, and she was driven off; and he did not say the takbīr until he no longer saw her."

records.text_en: From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from more than one [person], that ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb ؓ gathered the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, and asked them about the takbīr. He said to them: "Look at the last funeral over which the Prophet ﷺ said the takbīr." They found that he had said four takbīrs until he was taken. ʿUmar said: "So say four takbīrs."
records.text_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَن غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ جَمَعَ أَصْحَابَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَسَأَلَهُمْ عَنِ التَّكْبِيرِ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ: انْظُرُوا آخِرَ جَنَازَةٍ كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَوَجَدُوهُ قَدْ كَبَّرَ أَرْبَعًا حَتَّى قُبِضَ، قَالَ عُمَرُ: «فَكَبَّرُوا أَرْبَعًا»

records.text_en: From a man, from Saʿd ibn ʿUbāda, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "When the believer is placed in his grave, the angel comes to him, sits him up, and says: Who is your Lord? He says: God. He says: And who is your Prophet? He says: Muḥammad ﷺ. He says: And what is your religion? He says: Islam. He said: Then his grave is widened for him, and he is shown his seat in Paradise. If he is a disbeliever, the angel sits him up and says: Who is your Lord? He says: 'Hāh, I do not know,' like one who is lost about something. He says: Who is your Prophet? He says: 'Hāh, I do not know,' like one who is lost about something. He says: What is your religion? It is said: 'Hāh, I do not know.' He said: Then his grave is constricted upon him, and he sees his seat in the Fire, and [the angel] strikes him a blow that everything hears except the two weighty creations: jinn and humankind." Then the Messenger of God ﷺ recited: {God keeps firm those who believe with the firm word in the worldly life and in the Hereafter, and God leaves the wrongdoers astray, and God does what He wills} [Sūrat Ibrāhīm: 27].

records.text_en: From ʿAlqama, from Ibn Burayda, from his father, who said: We went out with the Prophet ﷺ, in a funeral procession, and he came to the grave of his mother, weeping with the most intense weeping, until his soul almost left from between his sides. He said: We said: "O Messenger of God, what makes you weep?" He said: "I asked my Lord's permission to visit the grave of Muḥammad's mother, and He permitted me; and I asked His permission for intercession, and He refused me." In a narration, he said: "The Prophet ﷺ asked permission to visit the grave of his mother and was permitted. He set out and the Muslims set out with him until they reached a place near the grave. The Muslims stayed, and the Prophet ﷺ went on and stayed a long while; then his weeping intensified until we thought he would not calm down. He came back weeping, and ʿUmar said to him: 'What made you weep, O Prophet of God, my father and mother be your ransom?' He said: 'I asked my Lord's permission to visit the grave of my mother, and He permitted me; and I asked His permission for intercession, and He refused. So I wept in mercy for her.' And the Muslims wept in mercy for the Prophet ﷺ."
records.text_ar: عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي جَنَازَةٍ، فَأَتَى قَبْرَ أُمِّهِ، وَهُوَ يَبْكِي أَشَدَّ الْبُكَاءِ، حَتَّى كَادَتْ نَفْسُهُ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ جَنْبَيْهِ، قَالَ: قُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا يُبْكِيكَ؟ قَالَ: «اسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَبِّي فِي زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِ أُمِّ مُحَمَّدٍ، فَأَذِنَ لِي، وَاسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ فِي الشَّفَاعَةِ فَأَبَى عَلَيَّ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، قَالَ: "اسْتَأْذَنَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِ أُمِّهِ، فَأُذِنَ لَهُ، فَانْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقَ مَعَهُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ حَتَّى انْتَهَوْا إِلَى قَرِيبٍ مِنَ الْقَبْرِ، فَمَكَثَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ، وَمَضَى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَمَكَثَ طَوِيلًا، ثُمَّ اشْتَدَّ بُكَاؤُهُ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ لَا يَسْكُنُ، فَأَقْبَلَ، وَهُوَ يَبْكِي، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: مَا أَبْكَاكَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي؟ قَالَ: اسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَبِّي فِي زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِ أُمِّي، فَأَذِنَ لِي، وَاسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ فِي الشَّفَاعَةِ، فَأَبَى، فَبَكَيْتُ رَحْمَةً لَهَا، وَبَكَى الْمُسْلِمُونَ رَحْمَةً لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ"

isnad.english: From ʿAlqama, from Ibn Burayda, from his father, who said:
isnad.arabic: عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:

matn.english: We went out with the Prophet ﷺ, in a funeral procession, and he came to the grave of his mother, weeping with the most intense weeping, until his soul almost left from between his sides. He said: We said: "O Messenger of God, what makes you weep?" He said: "I asked my Lord's permission to visit the grave of Muḥammad's mother, and He permitted me; and I asked His permission for intercession, and He refused me." In a narration, he said: "The Prophet ﷺ asked permission to visit the grave of his mother and was permitted. He set out and the Muslims set out with him until they reached a place near the grave. The Muslims stayed, and the Prophet ﷺ went on and stayed a long while; then his weeping intensified until we thought he would not calm down. He came back weeping, and ʿUmar said to him: 'What made you weep, O Prophet of God, my father and mother be your ransom?' He said: 'I asked my Lord's permission to visit the grave of my mother, and He permitted me; and I asked His permission for intercession, and He refused. So I wept in mercy for her.' And the Muslims wept in mercy for the Prophet ﷺ."

records.text_en: From Ismāʿīl, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Umm Hāniʾ ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "There is no believer who goes hungry for a day, and avoids what is forbidden, and does not consume the property of the Muslims wrongfully, but that God Almighty will feed him from the fruits of Paradise."

records.text_en: From ʿAbd Allāh, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Bilāl calls [the adhān] at night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktūm calls, for he gives the adhān when the prayer has become permissible."

records.text_en:
From Abū al-Sawwār, who is also called Abū al-Sawdāʾ, and he is al-Sulamī, from Abū Ḥājib, from Ibn ʿAbbās ؓ: "That the Messenger of God ﷺ was cupped at al-Qāḥa while fasting." In a narration, he said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ was cupped at al-Qāḥa while in a state of iḥrām and fasting."

In a narration: That the Prophet ﷺ, "was cupped and gave the cupper his wage, and had it been filthy he would not have given it."
records.text_ar:
عَنْ أَبِي السَّوَّارِ وَيُقَالُ أَبُو السَّوْدَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّلْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي حَاجِبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ احْتَجَمَ بِالْقَاحَةِ، وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، قَالَ: «احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْقَاحَةِ، وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ صَائِمٌ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «احْتَجَمَ وَأَعْطَى الْحَجَّامَ أَجْرَهُ، وَلَوْ كَانَ خَبِيثًا مَا أَعْطَاهُ»
records.isnad_en: From Abū al-Sawwār, who is also called Abū al-Sawdāʾ, and he is al-Sulamī, from Abū Ḥājib, from Ibn ʿAbbās ؓ:
records.matn_en:
"That the Messenger of God ﷺ was cupped at al-Qāḥa while fasting." In a narration, he said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ was cupped at al-Qāḥa while in a state of iḥrām and fasting."

In a narration: That the Prophet ﷺ, "was cupped and gave the cupper his wage, and had it been filthy he would not have given it."

records.matn_ar:
«أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ احْتَجَمَ بِالْقَاحَةِ، وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، قَالَ: «احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْقَاحَةِ، وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ صَائِمٌ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «احْتَجَمَ وَأَعْطَى الْحَجَّامَ أَجْرَهُ، وَلَوْ كَانَ خَبِيثًا مَا أَعْطَاهُ»

isnad.english: From Abū al-Sawwār, who is also called Abū al-Sawdāʾ, and he is al-Sulamī, from Abū Ḥājib, from Ibn ʿAbbās ؓ:
isnad.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي السَّوَّارِ وَيُقَالُ أَبُو السَّوْدَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّلْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي حَاجِبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا،

matn.english:
"That the Messenger of God ﷺ was cupped at al-Qāḥa while fasting." In a narration, he said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ was cupped at al-Qāḥa while in a state of iḥrām and fasting."

In a narration: That the Prophet ﷺ, "was cupped and gave the cupper his wage, and had it been filthy he would not have given it."
matn.arabic:
«أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ احْتَجَمَ بِالْقَاحَةِ، وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، قَالَ: «احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْقَاحَةِ، وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ صَائِمٌ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «احْتَجَمَ وَأَعْطَى الْحَجَّامَ أَجْرَهُ، وَلَوْ كَانَ خَبِيثًا مَا أَعْطَاهُ»

records.text_en:
From al-Zuhrī, from Anas ؓ: "That the Messenger of God ﷺ was cupped while fasting."

In a narration, Abū Ḥanīfa ؓ said: Ibn Shihāb informed me that the Messenger of God ﷺ, "was cupped while fasting."

And he did not mention Anas.
records.text_ar:
عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ احْتَجَمَ، وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، قَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «احْتَجَمَ، وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ».

وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَنَسًا

records.text_en: From al-Haytham ibn Ḥabīb al-Ṣayrafī, from Anas ibn Mālik ؓ, who said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ went out two nights having passed of the month of Ramadan, from Medina to Mecca, and fasted until he reached Qudayd. The people complained of hardship, so he broke his fast, and he continued breaking his fast until he reached Mecca."
records.text_ar: عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ الصَّيْرَفِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: «خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِلَيْلَتَيْنِ خَلَتَا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ، فَصَامَ حَتَّى أَتَى قُدَيْدَ، فَشَكَا النَّاسُ الْجَهْدَ، فَأَفْطَرَ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يُفْطِرُ حَتَّى أَتَى مَكَّةَ»

records.text_en:
From Muslim, who said: "The Prophet ﷺ traveled in Ramadan, intending Mecca, and fasted, and the people fasted with him." In a narration: "That he went out from Medina to Mecca in Ramadan and fasted until he reached some point on the road. The people complained to him of hardship, so he broke his fast, and he continued in a state of not fasting until he reached Mecca."

In a narration, he said: "The Prophet ﷺ traveled in Ramadan, intending Mecca, and fasted, and the Muslims fasted, until, when he was at some point on the road, some of the Muslims complained of hardship, so he called for water and broke his fast, and the Muslims broke their fast."
records.text_ar:
عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ: «سَافَرَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي رَمَضَانَ، يُرِيدُ مَكَّةَ، فَصَامَ وَصَامَ النَّاسُ مَعَهُ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «أَنَّهُ خَرَجَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فِي رَمَضَانَ، فَصَامَ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى بَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ، فَشَكَا النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ الْجَهْدَ، فَأَفْطَرَ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ مُفْطِرًا حَتَّى أَتَى مَكَّةَ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ، قَالَ: «سَافَرَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي رَمَضَانَ، يُرِيدُ مَكَّةَ، فَصَامَ وَصَامَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ، حَتَّى إذَا كَانَ بَعْضُ الطَّرِيقِ شَكَا بَعْضُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْجَهْدَ، فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ، فَأَفْطَرَ وَأَفْطَرَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ»

isnad.arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ قَزْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ:

matn.english: "That the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade fasting three days."
matn.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنْ صِيَامِ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ»

records.text_en: And with it: "That the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade fasting the day about which there is doubt whether it is of Ramadan."

records.text_en:
From Qays, from Ṭāriq, from Ibn Masʿūd ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "The best Hajj is al-ʿajj and al-thajj. As for al-ʿajj: [it is] al-ʿajuj [the raising of voices]; and as for al-thajj: the pouring [of the blood] of the sacrificial camels." Some of them said: "the pouring of blood."

In another narration: "As for al-thajj: it is the slaughtering of the sacrificial animal."
records.text_ar:
عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ طَارِقٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "أَفْضَلُ الْحَجِّ الْعَجُّ وَالثَّجُّ، فَأَمَّا الْعَجُّ: فَالْعَجُجُ، وَأَمَّا الثَّجُّ: فَثَجُّ الْبُدْنِ"، قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: فَثَجُّ الدَّمِ.

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ أُخْرَى: فَأَمَّا الثَّجُّ: فَنَحْرُ الْهَدْيِ

He said: "The people of Medina enter iḥrām from Dhū al-Ḥulayfa, the people of Iraq from al-ʿAqīq, the people of Syria from al-Juḥfa, and the people of Najd from Qarn."

records.text_en: From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad ibn Yazīd: That ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb ؓ addressed the people and said: "Whoever of you intends the Hajj, let him not enter iḥrām except from the mīqāt. The mīqāts which your Prophet ﷺ appointed: for the people of Medina, and whoever passes by it from other than its people, Dhū al-Ḥulayfa; for the people of Syria, and whoever passes by it from other than its people, al-Juḥfa; for the people of Najd, and whoever passes by it from other than its people, Qarn; for the people of Yemen, and whoever passes by it from other than its people, Yalamlam; and for the people of Iraq, and for all other people, Dhāt ʿIrq."
records.text_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ خَطَبَ النَّاسَ، فَقَالَ: «مَنْ أَرَادَ مِنْكُمُ الْحَجَّ، فَلَا يُحْرِمَنَّ إِلَّا مِنَ الْمِيقَاتِ، وَالْمَوَاقِيتُ الَّتِي وَقَّتَهَا نَبِيُّكُمْ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ، وَمَنْ مَرَّ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَهْلِهَا ذُو الْحُلَيْفَةِ، وَلِأَهْلِ الشَّامِ، وَمَنْ مَرَّ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَهْلِهَا الْجُحْفَةُ، وَلِأَهْلِ نَجْدٍ، وَمَنْ مَرَّ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَهْلِهَا قَرْنٌ، وَلِأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ، وَمَنْ مَرَّ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَهْلِهَا يَلَمْلَمُ، وَلِأَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ، وَلِسَائِرِ النَّاسِ ذَاتُ عِرْقٍ»

records.matn_en: That ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb ؓ addressed the people and said: "Whoever of you intends the Hajj, let him not enter iḥrām except from the mīqāt. records.text_en: From ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar ؓ, who said: "O Messenger of God, what clothes may the muḥrim wear?" He said: "He does not wear the shirt, nor the turban, nor the coat, nor trousers, nor hooded cloaks, nor a garment touched by wars or saffron; and whoever has no sandals, let him wear leather socks and cut them below the ankles."
records.text_ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَاذَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنَ الثِّيَابِ؟ قَالَ: «لَا يَلْبِسُ الْقَمِيصَ، وَلَا الْعِمَامَةَ، وَلَا الْقِبَاءَ، وَلَا السَّرَاوِيلَ، وَلَا الْبَرَانِسَ، وَلَا ثَوْبًا مَسَّهُ وَرْسٌ أَوْ زَعْفَرَانُ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ نَعْلَانِ، فَلْيَلْبَسِ الْخُفَّيْنِ، وَلْيَقْطَعْهُمَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ»

records.text_en: From Ibrāhīm, from his father, who said: I asked Ibn ʿUmar ؓ: "May the muḥrim apply perfume?" In a narration: "I used to perfume the Prophet ﷺ, then he would go round among his wives, then wake in the morning in a state of iḥrām."
records.text_ar: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَيَتَطَيَّبُ الْمُحْرِمُ؟ قَالَ: «لِأَنْ أُصْبِحَ أَنْضَخُ قَطِرَانًا، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُصْبِحَ أَنْضَخُ طِيبًا»، فَأَتَيْتُ عَائِشَةَ، فَذَكَرْتُ لَهَا، فَقَالَتْ: "أَنَا طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَطَافَ فِي أَزْوَاجِهِ، ثُمَّ أَصْبَحَ تَعْنِي: مُحْرِمًا"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ثُمَّ يَطُوفُ فِي نِسَائِهِ، ثُمَّ يُصْبِحُ مُحْرِمًا»

records.text_en: From Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir ؓ, who said: When the Messenger of God ﷺ commanded what he commanded in the Farewell Hajj, Surāqa ibn Mālik said: "O Messenger of God, tell us about our ʿumra: is it for us in particular, or for all time?" He said: "It is for all time."
records.text_ar: عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: لَمَّا أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمَا أَمَرَ بِهِ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، قَالَ سُرَاقَةُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَخْبِرْنَا عَنْ عُمْرَتِنَا، أَلَنَا خَاصَّةً أَمْ لِلْأَبَدِ؟ قَالَ: «هِيَ لِلْأَبَدِ»

records.text_en: From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾisha ؓ, that she said: "O Prophet of God, the people return with a Hajj and an ʿumra, and I return with a Hajj?" records.text_en: From Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Abū Qatāda, who said: "I went out with a group of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, and there was no one in the group not in iḥrām except me. I saw an ostrich and went to my horse and mounted it, having been in too much of a hurry to take my whip. I said to them: 'Hand it to me,' but they refused. So I dismounted, took my whip, and pursued the ostrich, and took some meat from it, and I ate and they ate."

records.text_en: From ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar: That the Prophet ﷺ used to say between the Corner and the Black Stone: "O God, I seek refuge in You from disbelief, poverty, humiliation, and the stations of disgrace in this world and the Hereafter."

records.text_en: From Yaḥyā ibn Abī Ḥayya Abū Junāb, from Hānī ibn Zayd, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: "We went on with him from ʿArafāt, and when we alighted at Jamʿ, he called the iqāma, and we prayed Maghrib with him. Then he went forward and prayed two rakʿas, then called for water, and it was poured on him, then he went to his bed. We sat awaiting the prayer for a long time, then said: 'O Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, the prayer.' He said: 'Which prayer?' We said: 'The last ʿishāʾ.' He said: 'As for [praying] as the Messenger of God ﷺ prayed, I have prayed.'" In a narration, from Ibn ʿUmar ؓ: That the Prophet ﷺ, "combined Maghrib and ʿishāʾ."
records.text_ar: عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي حَيَّةَ أَبِي جُنَابٍ، عَنْ هَانِئِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: "أَفَضْنَا مَعَهُ مِنْ عَرَفَاتٍ، فَلَمَّا نَزَلْنَا جَمْعًا أَقَامَ، فَصَلَّيْنَا الْمَغْرِبَ مَعَهُ، ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ، فَصُبَّ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ، فَقَعَدْنَا نَنْتَظِرُ الصَّلَاةَ طَوِيلًا، ثُمَّ قُلْنَا: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، الصَّلَاةَ، فَقَالَ: أَيُّ صَلَاةٍ؟ فَقُلْنَا: الْعِشَاءُ الْآخِرَةُ، فَقَالَ: أَمَّا كَمَا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَدْ صَلَّيْتُ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ»

matn.arabic: "أَفَضْنَا مَعَهُ مِنْ عَرَفَاتٍ، فَلَمَّا نَزَلْنَا جَمْعًا أَقَامَ، فَصَلَّيْنَا الْمَغْرِبَ مَعَهُ، ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ، فَصُبَّ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ، فَقَعَدْنَا نَنْتَظِرُ الصَّلَاةَ طَوِيلًا، ثُمَّ قُلْنَا: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، الصَّلَاةَ، فَقَالَ: أَيُّ صَلَاةٍ؟ فَقُلْنَا: الْعِشَاءُ الْآخِرَةُ، فَقَالَ: أَمَّا كَمَا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَدْ صَلَّيْتُ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ»

records.text_en:
From ʿAṭāʾ, from Ibn ʿAbbās ؓ: "That the Prophet ﷺ pronounced the talbiya until he stoned Jamrat al-ʿAqaba." In a narration, from Ibn ʿAbbās ؓ: That the Prophet ﷺ, "had al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbbās ؓ ride behind him, and he was a handsome youth, and he began to glance at the women, while the Prophet ﷺ would turn his face away; and he pronounced the talbiya until he stoned Jamrat al-ʿAqaba."

In a narration, from Ibn ʿAbbās ؓ, from al-Faḍl, his brother: That the Prophet ﷺ, "did not cease pronouncing the talbiya until he stoned Jamrat al-ʿAqaba."
records.text_ar:
عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَبَّى حَتَّى رَمَى جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ»، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «أَرْدَفَ الْفَضْلَ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، وَكَانَ غُلَامًا حَسَنًا، فَجَعَلَ يُلَاحِظُ النِّسَاءَ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَصْرِفُ وَجْهَهُ، فَلَبَّى حَتَّى رَمَى جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ الْفَضْلِ أَخِيهِ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «لَمْ يَزَلْ يُلَبِّي حَتَّى رَمَى جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ»

records.text_en:
From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Ḍabbī ibn Maʿbad, who said: I came from al-Jazīra on Hajj, and passed Salmān ibn Rabīʿa and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān, who were two old men at al-ʿUdhayba, and they heard me say: "'Labbayka with an ʿumra and a Hajj.' One of them said: 'This person is more astray than his camel,' and the other said: 'This one is more astray than such and such.' He said: I went on until, when I had completed my rites, I passed the Commander of the Believers, ʿUmar, and informed him: 'I was a man of a distant journey, far-off home; God Almighty permitted this trip, so I loved to combine an ʿumra with a Hajj, and I entered iḥrām for both together, and I did not forget. Then I passed Salmān ibn Rabīʿa and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān, and they heard me say: Labbayka with an ʿumra and a Hajj together. One of them said: This one is more astray than his camel, and the other said: This one is more astray than such and such.' ʿUmar said: 'Then what?' He said: 'I went on and circumambulated a circumambulation for my ʿumra, and ran a sāʿy for my ʿumra, and I did [the rest]; then I returned and did likewise; then I remained in iḥrām, doing as the pilgrim does, until I completed the last of my rites.

ʿUmar said: 'You were guided to the sunna of your Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ.'"

In a narration, from al-Ḍabbī ibn Maʿbad, he said: I was newly out of Christianity, and I came to Kūfa intending the Hajj in the time of ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb ؓ. Salmān ibn Rabīʿa and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān entered iḥrām for the Hajj alone, and al-Ḍabbī entered iḥrām for the Hajj and the ʿumra. [One of them] said: "Woe to you, you have performed tamattuʿ, and the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade the mutʿa." They said to him: "By God, you are more astray than your camel." He said: "We will come to ʿUmar, and you will come." When al-Ḍabbī reached Mecca, he circumambulated the House and ran between Ṣafā and Marwa for his ʿumra, then returned in iḥrām, not coming out of it at all, then circumambulated the House and between Ṣafā and Marwa for his Hajj, then stayed in iḥrām, not coming out of it, until he came to ʿArafāt and finished his Hajj. When it was the Day of Sacrifice he came out of iḥrām and shed blood for his tamattuʿ. When they returned from their Hajj they passed ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb ؓ, and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān said to him: "O Commander of the Believers, you forbade the mutʿa, and al-Ḍabbī ibn Maʿbad has performed tamattuʿ." He said: "What did you do, O Ḍabbī?" He said: "I entered iḥrām, O Commander of the Believers, for the Hajj and the ʿumra. When I came to Mecca I circumambulated the House and went between Ṣafā and Marwa for my ʿumra, then returned in iḥrām, not coming out of it at all, then I circumambulated the House and between Ṣafā and Marwa for my Hajj, then I stayed in iḥrām until the Day of Sacrifice, and I shed blood for my tamattuʿ, then I came out of iḥrām." He said: So ʿUmar struck his back and said: "You were guided to the sunna of your Prophet ﷺ."

In a narration, from al-Ḍabbī, he said: He went out, together with Salmān ibn Rabīʿa and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān, intending the Hajj. He said: As for al-Ḍabbī, he combined the Hajj and the ʿumra together, and as for Salmān and Zayd, they performed the Hajj alone. Then they turned to al-Ḍabbī, blaming him for what he did, and said to him: "You are more astray than your camel, combining the Hajj and the ʿumra, when the Commander of the Believers has forbidden the ʿumra and the Hajj." He said: "You will come to ʿUmar, and I will come." They went on until they entered Mecca. He circumambulated the House for his ʿumra and ran between Ṣafā and Marwa for his ʿumra, then returned and circumambulated the House for his Hajj, then ran between Ṣafā and Marwa, then stayed as he was, with nothing that was forbidden to him becoming lawful, until, when it was the Day of Sacrifice, he slaughtered what was easily available of the offering, a sheep. When they completed their rites, they passed through Medina and entered upon ʿUmar ؓ. Salmān and Zayd said to him: "Al-Ḍabbī combined the Hajj and the ʿumra." He said: "Then what did you do?" He said: "When I came to Mecca, I circumambulated a circumambulation for my ʿumra, then ran between Ṣafā and Marwa for my ʿumra, then returned and circumambulated the House for my Hajj, then ran between Ṣafā and Marwa for my Hajj." He said: "Then what did you do?" He said: "I stayed in iḥrām, with nothing that had been forbidden to me becoming lawful, until, when it was the Day of Sacrifice, I slaughtered what was easily available of the offering, a sheep." He said: So ʿUmar struck his shoulder, then said: "You were guided to the sunna of your Prophet ﷺ."
records.text_ar:
عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الضَّبِّيِّ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ، قَالَ: أَقْبَلْتُ مِنَ الْجَزَيرَةِ حَاجًّا، فَمَرَرْتُ بِسَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ صُوحَانَ، وَهُمَا شَيْخَانِ بِالْعُذَيْبَةِ، فَسَمِعَانِي أَقُولُ: "لَبَّيْكَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَحَجَّةٍ، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا: هَذَا الشَّخْصُ أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِهِ، وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ: هَذَا أَضَلُّ مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ: فَمَضَيْتُ حَتَّى إِذَا قَضَيْتُ نُسُكِي مَرَرْتُ بِأَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عُمَرَ، فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ: كُنْتُ رَجُلًا بَعِيدَ الشُّقَّةِ، قَاصِيَ الدَّارِ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِي هَذا الْوَجْهِ، فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَجْمَعَ عُمْرَةً إِلَى حَجَّةً، فَأَهْلَلْتُ بِهِمَا جَمِيعًا، وَلَمْ أَنْسَ، فَمَرَرْتُ بِسَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ صُوحَانَ، فَسَمِعَانِي أَقُولُ: لَبَّيْكَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَحَجَّةٍ مَعًا، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا: هَذَا أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِهِ، وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ: هَذَا أَضَلُّ كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ عُمَرُ: ثُمَّ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: مَضَيْتُ، فَطُفْتُ طَوَافًا لِعُمْرَتِي، وَسَعَيْتُ سَعْيًا لِعُمْرَتِي، فَصَنَعْتُ، ثُمَّ عُدْتُ، فَفَعَلْتُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ بَقِيتُ حَرَامًا أَصْنَعُ كَمَا يَصْنَعُ الْحَاجُّ، حَتَّى إِذَا قَضَيْتُ آخِرَ نُسُكِي.

قَالَ عُمَرُ: هُدِيتَ لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ عَنِ الضَّبِّيِّ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ، قَالَ: كُنْتُ حَدِيثَ عَهْدٍ بِالْنَصْرَانِيَّةِ، فَقَدِمْتُ الْكُوفَةَ أُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ فِي زَمَانِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، فَأَهَلَّ سَلْمَانُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ بِالْحَجِّ وَحْدَهُ، وَأَهَلَّ الضَّبِّيُّ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، فَقَالَ: وَيْحَكَ تَمَتَّعْتَ، وَقَدْ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ، فَقَالَا لَهُ: وَاللَّهِ لَأَنْتَ أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِكَ، قَالَ: نَقْدُمُ عَلَى عُمَرَ وَتَقْدُمُونَ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ الضَّبِّيُّ مَكَّةَ طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ، وَسَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِعُمْرَتِهِ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ حَرَامًا لَمْ يَحْلُلْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ، ثُمَّ طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِحَجِّهِ، ثُمَّ أَقَامَ حَرَامًا لَمْ يَحْلُلْ مِنْهُ حَتَّى أَتَى عَرَفَاتٍ، وَفَرَغَ مِنْ حَجَّتِهِ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ حَلَّ فَأَهْرَقَ دَمًا لِمُتْعَتِهِ، فَلَمَّا صَدَرُوا مِنْ حَجِّهِمْ مَرُّوا بِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ زَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، إِنَّكَ نَهَيْتَ عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ، وَإِنَّ الضَّبِّيَّ بْنَ مَعْبَدٍ قَدْ تَمَتَّعَ، قَالَ: صَنَعْتَ مَاذَا يَا ضَبِّيُّ؟ قَالَ: أَهْلَلْتُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ طُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَطُفْتُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِعُمْرَتِي، ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ حَرَامًا لَمْ أَحْلُلْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ، ثُمَّ طُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِحَجَّتِي، ثُمَّ أَقَمْتُ حَرَامًا حَتَّى كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ، فَأَهْرَقْتُ دَمًا لِمُتْعَتِي، ثُمَّ أَحْلَلْتُ، قَالَ: فَضَرَبَ عُمَرُ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ، وَقَالَ: «هُدِيتَ لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ عَنِ الضَّبِّيِّ، قَالَ: خَرَجَ هُوَ وَسَلْمَانُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ يُرِيدُونَ الْحَجَّ، قَالَ: فَأَمَّا الضَّبِّيُّ فَقَرَنَ الْحَجَّةَ وَالْعُمْرَةَ جَمِيعًا، وَأَمَّا سَلْمَانُ وَزَيْدٌ فَأَفْرَدُوا الْحَجَّ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَا عَلَى الضَّبِّيِّ يَلُومَانِهُ فِيمَا صَنَعَ، ثُمَّ قَالَا لَهُ: أَنْتَ أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِكَ، تَقْرِنُ بَيْنَ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، وَقَدْ نَهَى أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَنِ الْعُمْرَةِ وَالْحَجِّ، قَالَ: تَقْدُمُونَ عَلَى عُمَرَ وَأَقْدُمُ، فَمَضَوْا حَتَّى دَخَلُوا مَكَّةَ، فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ لِعُمْرَتِهِ، وَسَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوةِ لِعُمْرَتِهِ، ثُمَّ عَادَ وَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ لِحَجَّتِهِ، ثُمَّ سَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، ثُمَّ أَقَامَ كَمَا هُوَ لَمْ يَحِلَّ لَهُ شَيْءٌ حَرَامٌ عَلَيْهِ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ ذَبَحَ مَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ شَاةً، فَلَمَّا قَضَوْا نُسُكَهُمْ مَرُّوا بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَدَخَلُوا عَلَى عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ سَلْمَانُ وَزَيْدٌ: إِنَّ الضَّبِّيَّ قَرَنَ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ صَنَعْتَ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: لَمَّا قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ طُفْتُ طَوَافًا لِعُمْرَتِي، ثُمَّ سَعَيْتُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِعُمْرَتِي، ثُمَّ عُدْتُ فَطُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ لِحَجَّتِي، ثُمَّ سَعَيْتُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِحَجَّتِي، قَالَ: ثُمَّ صَنَعْتَ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: أَقَمْتُ حَرَامًا لَمْ يَحِلَّ لِي شَيْءٌ حُرِّمَ عَلَيَّ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ ذَبَحْتُ مَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ شَاةً، قَالَ: فَضَرَبَ عُمَرُ عَلَى كَتِفِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «هُدِيتَ لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ»

When they returned from their Hajj they passed ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb ؓ, and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān said to him: "O Commander of the Believers, you forbade the mutʿa, and al-Ḍabbī ibn Maʿbad has performed tamattuʿ." He said: "What did you do, O Ḍabbī?" He said: "I entered iḥrām, O Commander of the Believers, for the Hajj and the ʿumra. When I came to Mecca I circumambulated the House and went between Ṣafā and Marwa for my ʿumra, then returned in iḥrām, not coming out of it at all, then I circumambulated the House and between Ṣafā and Marwa for my Hajj, then I stayed in iḥrām until the Day of Sacrifice, and I shed blood for my tamattuʿ, then I came out of iḥrām." He said: So ʿUmar struck his back and said: "You were guided to the sunna of your Prophet ﷺ."

In a narration, from al-Ḍabbī, he said: He went out, together with Salmān ibn Rabīʿa and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān, intending the Hajj. He said: As for al-Ḍabbī, he combined the Hajj and the ʿumra together, and as for Salmān and Zayd, they performed the Hajj alone. Then they turned to al-Ḍabbī, blaming him for what he did, and said to him: "You are more astray than your camel, combining the Hajj and the ʿumra, when the Commander of the Believers has forbidden the ʿumra and the Hajj." He said: "You will come to ʿUmar, and I will come." They went on until they entered Mecca. He circumambulated the House for his ʿumra and ran between Ṣafā and Marwa for his ʿumra, then returned and circumambulated the House for his Hajj, then ran between Ṣafā and Marwa, then stayed as he was, with nothing that was forbidden to him becoming lawful, until, when it was the Day of Sacrifice, he slaughtered what was easily available of the offering, a sheep. When they completed their rites, they passed through Medina and entered upon ʿUmar ؓ. Salmān and Zayd said to him: "Al-Ḍabbī combined the Hajj and the ʿumra." He said: "Then what did you do?" He said: "When I came to Mecca, I circumambulated a circumambulation for my ʿumra, then ran between Ṣafā and Marwa for my ʿumra, then returned and circumambulated the House for my Hajj, then ran between Ṣafā and Marwa for my Hajj." He said: "Then what did you do?" He said: "I stayed in iḥrām, with nothing that had been forbidden to me becoming lawful, until, when it was the Day of Sacrifice, I slaughtered what was easily available of the offering, a sheep." He said: So ʿUmar struck his shoulder, then said: "You were guided to the sunna of your Prophet ﷺ."
records.isnad_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الضَّبِّيِّ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar:
أَقْبَلْتُ مِنَ الْجَزَيرَةِ حَاجًّا، فَمَرَرْتُ بِسَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ صُوحَانَ، وَهُمَا شَيْخَانِ بِالْعُذَيْبَةِ، فَسَمِعَانِي أَقُولُ: "لَبَّيْكَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَحَجَّةٍ، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا: هَذَا الشَّخْصُ أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِهِ، وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ: هَذَا أَضَلُّ مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ: فَمَضَيْتُ حَتَّى إِذَا قَضَيْتُ نُسُكِي مَرَرْتُ بِأَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عُمَرَ، فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ: كُنْتُ رَجُلًا بَعِيدَ الشُّقَّةِ، قَاصِيَ الدَّارِ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِي هَذا الْوَجْهِ، فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَجْمَعَ عُمْرَةً إِلَى حَجَّةً، فَأَهْلَلْتُ بِهِمَا جَمِيعًا، وَلَمْ أَنْسَ، فَمَرَرْتُ بِسَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ صُوحَانَ، فَسَمِعَانِي أَقُولُ: لَبَّيْكَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَحَجَّةٍ مَعًا، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا: هَذَا أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِهِ، وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ: هَذَا أَضَلُّ كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ عُمَرُ: ثُمَّ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: مَضَيْتُ، فَطُفْتُ طَوَافًا لِعُمْرَتِي، وَسَعَيْتُ سَعْيًا لِعُمْرَتِي، فَصَنَعْتُ، ثُمَّ عُدْتُ، فَفَعَلْتُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ بَقِيتُ حَرَامًا أَصْنَعُ كَمَا يَصْنَعُ الْحَاجُّ، حَتَّى إِذَا قَضَيْتُ آخِرَ نُسُكِي.

قَالَ عُمَرُ: هُدِيتَ لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ عَنِ الضَّبِّيِّ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ، قَالَ: كُنْتُ حَدِيثَ عَهْدٍ بِالْنَصْرَانِيَّةِ، فَقَدِمْتُ الْكُوفَةَ أُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ فِي زَمَانِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، فَأَهَلَّ سَلْمَانُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ بِالْحَجِّ وَحْدَهُ، وَأَهَلَّ الضَّبِّيُّ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، فَقَالَ: وَيْحَكَ تَمَتَّعْتَ، وَقَدْ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ، فَقَالَا لَهُ: وَاللَّهِ لَأَنْتَ أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِكَ، قَالَ: نَقْدُمُ عَلَى عُمَرَ وَتَقْدُمُونَ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ الضَّبِّيُّ مَكَّةَ طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ، وَسَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِعُمْرَتِهِ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ حَرَامًا لَمْ يَحْلُلْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ، ثُمَّ طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِحَجِّهِ، ثُمَّ أَقَامَ حَرَامًا لَمْ يَحْلُلْ مِنْهُ حَتَّى أَتَى عَرَفَاتٍ، وَفَرَغَ مِنْ حَجَّتِهِ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ حَلَّ فَأَهْرَقَ دَمًا لِمُتْعَتِهِ، فَلَمَّا صَدَرُوا مِنْ حَجِّهِمْ مَرُّوا بِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ زَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، إِنَّكَ نَهَيْتَ عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ، وَإِنَّ الضَّبِّيَّ بْنَ مَعْبَدٍ قَدْ تَمَتَّعَ، قَالَ: صَنَعْتَ مَاذَا يَا ضَبِّيُّ؟ قَالَ: أَهْلَلْتُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ طُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَطُفْتُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِعُمْرَتِي، ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ حَرَامًا لَمْ أَحْلُلْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ، ثُمَّ طُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِحَجَّتِي، ثُمَّ أَقَمْتُ حَرَامًا حَتَّى كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ، فَأَهْرَقْتُ دَمًا لِمُتْعَتِي، ثُمَّ أَحْلَلْتُ، قَالَ: فَضَرَبَ عُمَرُ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ، وَقَالَ: «هُدِيتَ لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ عَنِ الضَّبِّيِّ، قَالَ: خَرَجَ هُوَ وَسَلْمَانُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ يُرِيدُونَ الْحَجَّ، قَالَ: فَأَمَّا الضَّبِّيُّ فَقَرَنَ الْحَجَّةَ وَالْعُمْرَةَ جَمِيعًا، وَأَمَّا سَلْمَانُ وَزَيْدٌ فَأَفْرَدُوا الْحَجَّ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَا عَلَى الضَّبِّيِّ يَلُومَانِهُ فِيمَا صَنَعَ، ثُمَّ قَالَا لَهُ: أَنْتَ أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِكَ، تَقْرِنُ بَيْنَ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، وَقَدْ نَهَى أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَنِ الْعُمْرَةِ وَالْحَجِّ، قَالَ: تَقْدُمُونَ عَلَى عُمَرَ وَأَقْدُمُ، فَمَضَوْا حَتَّى دَخَلُوا مَكَّةَ، فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ لِعُمْرَتِهِ، وَسَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوةِ لِعُمْرَتِهِ، ثُمَّ عَادَ وَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ لِحَجَّتِهِ، ثُمَّ سَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، ثُمَّ أَقَامَ كَمَا هُوَ لَمْ يَحِلَّ لَهُ شَيْءٌ حَرَامٌ عَلَيْهِ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ ذَبَحَ مَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ شَاةً، فَلَمَّا قَضَوْا نُسُكَهُمْ مَرُّوا بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَدَخَلُوا عَلَى عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ سَلْمَانُ وَزَيْدٌ: إِنَّ الضَّبِّيَّ قَرَنَ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ صَنَعْتَ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: لَمَّا قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ طُفْتُ طَوَافًا لِعُمْرَتِي، ثُمَّ سَعَيْتُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِعُمْرَتِي، ثُمَّ عُدْتُ فَطُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ لِحَجَّتِي، ثُمَّ سَعَيْتُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِحَجَّتِي، قَالَ: ثُمَّ صَنَعْتَ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: أَقَمْتُ حَرَامًا لَمْ يَحِلَّ لِي شَيْءٌ حُرِّمَ عَلَيَّ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ ذَبَحْتُ مَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ شَاةً، قَالَ: فَضَرَبَ عُمَرُ عَلَى كَتِفِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «هُدِيتَ لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ»

isnad.english: From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Ḍabbī ibn Maʿbad, who said:
isnad.arabic: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الضَّبِّيِّ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ، قَالَ:

matn.english:
I came from al-Jazīra on Hajj, and passed Salmān ibn Rabīʿa and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān, who were two old men at al-ʿUdhayba, and they heard me say: "'Labbayka with an ʿumra and a Hajj.' One of them said: 'This person is more astray than his camel,' and the other said: 'This one is more astray than such and such.' He said: I went on until, when I had completed my rites, I passed the Commander of the Believers, ʿUmar, and informed him: 'I was a man of a distant journey, far-off home; God Almighty permitted this trip, so I loved to combine an ʿumra with a Hajj, and I entered iḥrām for both together, and I did not forget. Then I passed Salmān ibn Rabīʿa and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān, and they heard me say: Labbayka with an ʿumra and a Hajj together. One of them said: This one is more astray than his camel, and the other said: This one is more astray than such and such.' ʿUmar said: 'Then what?' He said: 'I went on and circumambulated a circumambulation for my ʿumra, and ran a sāʿy for my ʿumra, and I did [the rest]; then I returned and did likewise; then I remained in iḥrām, doing as the pilgrim does, until I completed the last of my rites.

ʿUmar said: 'You were guided to the sunna of your Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ.'"

In a narration, from al-Ḍabbī ibn Maʿbad, he said: I was newly out of Christianity, and I came to Kūfa intending the Hajj in the time of ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb ؓ. Salmān ibn Rabīʿa and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān entered iḥrām for the Hajj alone, and al-Ḍabbī entered iḥrām for the Hajj and the ʿumra. [One of them] said: "Woe to you, you have performed tamattuʿ, and the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade the mutʿa." They said to him: "By God, you are more astray than your camel." He said: "We will come to ʿUmar, and you will come." When al-Ḍabbī reached Mecca, he circumambulated the House and ran between Ṣafā and Marwa for his ʿumra, then returned in iḥrām, not coming out of it at all, then circumambulated the House and between Ṣafā and Marwa for his Hajj, then stayed in iḥrām, not coming out of it, until he came to ʿArafāt and finished his Hajj. When it was the Day of Sacrifice he came out of iḥrām and shed blood for his tamattuʿ. When they returned from their Hajj they passed ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb ؓ, and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān said to him: "O Commander of the Believers, you forbade the mutʿa, and al-Ḍabbī ibn Maʿbad has performed tamattuʿ." He said: "What did you do, O Ḍabbī?" He said: "I entered iḥrām, O Commander of the Believers, for the Hajj and the ʿumra. When I came to Mecca I circumambulated the House and went between Ṣafā and Marwa for my ʿumra, then returned in iḥrām, not coming out of it at all, then I circumambulated the House and between Ṣafā and Marwa for my Hajj, then I stayed in iḥrām until the Day of Sacrifice, and I shed blood for my tamattuʿ, then I came out of iḥrām." He said: So ʿUmar struck his back and said: "You were guided to the sunna of your Prophet ﷺ."

In a narration, from al-Ḍabbī, he said: He went out, together with Salmān ibn Rabīʿa and Zayd ibn Ṣūḥān, intending the Hajj. He said: As for al-Ḍabbī, he combined the Hajj and the ʿumra together, and as for Salmān and Zayd, they performed the Hajj alone. Then they turned to al-Ḍabbī, blaming him for what he did, and said to him: "You are more astray than your camel, combining the Hajj and the ʿumra, when the Commander of the Believers has forbidden the ʿumra and the Hajj." When they completed their rites, they passed through Medina and entered upon ʿUmar ؓ. Salmān and Zayd said to him: "Al-Ḍabbī combined the Hajj and the ʿumra." He said: "Then what did you do?" He said: "When I came to Mecca, I circumambulated a circumambulation for my ʿumra, then ran between Ṣafā and Marwa for my ʿumra, then returned and circumambulated the House for my Hajj, then ran between Ṣafā and Marwa for my Hajj." He said: So ʿUmar struck his shoulder, then said: "You were guided to the sunna of your Prophet ﷺ."
matn.arabic:
أَقْبَلْتُ مِنَ الْجَزَيرَةِ حَاجًّا، فَمَرَرْتُ بِسَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ صُوحَانَ، وَهُمَا شَيْخَانِ بِالْعُذَيْبَةِ، فَسَمِعَانِي أَقُولُ: "لَبَّيْكَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَحَجَّةٍ، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا: هَذَا الشَّخْصُ أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِهِ، وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ: هَذَا أَضَلُّ مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ: فَمَضَيْتُ حَتَّى إِذَا قَضَيْتُ نُسُكِي مَرَرْتُ بِأَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عُمَرَ، فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ: كُنْتُ رَجُلًا بَعِيدَ الشُّقَّةِ، قَاصِيَ الدَّارِ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِي هَذا الْوَجْهِ، فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَجْمَعَ عُمْرَةً إِلَى حَجَّةً، فَأَهْلَلْتُ بِهِمَا جَمِيعًا، وَلَمْ أَنْسَ، فَمَرَرْتُ بِسَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ صُوحَانَ، فَسَمِعَانِي أَقُولُ: لَبَّيْكَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَحَجَّةٍ مَعًا، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا: هَذَا أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِهِ، وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ: هَذَا أَضَلُّ كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ عُمَرُ: ثُمَّ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: مَضَيْتُ، فَطُفْتُ طَوَافًا لِعُمْرَتِي، وَسَعَيْتُ سَعْيًا لِعُمْرَتِي، فَصَنَعْتُ، ثُمَّ عُدْتُ، فَفَعَلْتُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ بَقِيتُ حَرَامًا أَصْنَعُ كَمَا يَصْنَعُ الْحَاجُّ، حَتَّى إِذَا قَضَيْتُ آخِرَ نُسُكِي.

قَالَ عُمَرُ: هُدِيتَ لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ"، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ عَنِ الضَّبِّيِّ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ، قَالَ: كُنْتُ حَدِيثَ عَهْدٍ بِالْنَصْرَانِيَّةِ، فَقَدِمْتُ الْكُوفَةَ أُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ فِي زَمَانِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، فَأَهَلَّ سَلْمَانُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ بِالْحَجِّ وَحْدَهُ، وَأَهَلَّ الضَّبِّيُّ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، فَقَالَ: وَيْحَكَ تَمَتَّعْتَ، وَقَدْ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ، فَقَالَا لَهُ: وَاللَّهِ لَأَنْتَ أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِكَ، قَالَ: نَقْدُمُ عَلَى عُمَرَ وَتَقْدُمُونَ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ الضَّبِّيُّ مَكَّةَ طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ، وَسَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِعُمْرَتِهِ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ حَرَامًا لَمْ يَحْلُلْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ، ثُمَّ طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِحَجِّهِ، ثُمَّ أَقَامَ حَرَامًا لَمْ يَحْلُلْ مِنْهُ حَتَّى أَتَى عَرَفَاتٍ، وَفَرَغَ مِنْ حَجَّتِهِ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ حَلَّ فَأَهْرَقَ دَمًا لِمُتْعَتِهِ، فَلَمَّا صَدَرُوا مِنْ حَجِّهِمْ مَرُّوا بِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ زَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، إِنَّكَ نَهَيْتَ عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ، وَإِنَّ الضَّبِّيَّ بْنَ مَعْبَدٍ قَدْ تَمَتَّعَ، قَالَ: صَنَعْتَ مَاذَا يَا ضَبِّيُّ؟ قَالَ: أَهْلَلْتُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ طُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَطُفْتُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِعُمْرَتِي، ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ حَرَامًا لَمْ أَحْلُلْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ، ثُمَّ طُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِحَجَّتِي، ثُمَّ أَقَمْتُ حَرَامًا حَتَّى كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ، فَأَهْرَقْتُ دَمًا لِمُتْعَتِي، ثُمَّ أَحْلَلْتُ، قَالَ: فَضَرَبَ عُمَرُ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ، وَقَالَ: «هُدِيتَ لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ عَنِ الضَّبِّيِّ، قَالَ: خَرَجَ هُوَ وَسَلْمَانُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ يُرِيدُونَ الْحَجَّ، قَالَ: فَأَمَّا الضَّبِّيُّ فَقَرَنَ الْحَجَّةَ وَالْعُمْرَةَ جَمِيعًا، وَأَمَّا سَلْمَانُ وَزَيْدٌ فَأَفْرَدُوا الْحَجَّ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَا عَلَى الضَّبِّيِّ يَلُومَانِهُ فِيمَا صَنَعَ، ثُمَّ قَالَا لَهُ: أَنْتَ أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِكَ، تَقْرِنُ بَيْنَ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، وَقَدْ نَهَى أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَنِ الْعُمْرَةِ وَالْحَجِّ، قَالَ: تَقْدُمُونَ عَلَى عُمَرَ وَأَقْدُمُ، فَمَضَوْا حَتَّى دَخَلُوا مَكَّةَ، فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ لِعُمْرَتِهِ، وَسَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوةِ لِعُمْرَتِهِ، ثُمَّ عَادَ وَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ لِحَجَّتِهِ، ثُمَّ سَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، ثُمَّ أَقَامَ كَمَا هُوَ لَمْ يَحِلَّ لَهُ شَيْءٌ حَرَامٌ عَلَيْهِ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ ذَبَحَ مَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ شَاةً، فَلَمَّا قَضَوْا نُسُكَهُمْ مَرُّوا بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَدَخَلُوا عَلَى عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ سَلْمَانُ وَزَيْدٌ: إِنَّ الضَّبِّيَّ قَرَنَ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ صَنَعْتَ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: لَمَّا قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ طُفْتُ طَوَافًا لِعُمْرَتِي، ثُمَّ سَعَيْتُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِعُمْرَتِي، ثُمَّ عُدْتُ فَطُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ لِحَجَّتِي، ثُمَّ سَعَيْتُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِحَجَّتِي، قَالَ: ثُمَّ صَنَعْتَ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: أَقَمْتُ حَرَامًا لَمْ يَحِلَّ لِي شَيْءٌ حُرِّمَ عَلَيَّ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ ذَبَحْتُ مَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ شَاةً، قَالَ: فَضَرَبَ عُمَرُ عَلَى كَتِفِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «هُدِيتَ لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ»

records.text_en: From ʿAṭāʾ, from Ibn ʿAbbās, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "An ʿumra in Ramadan equals a Hajj."

records.text_en: From ʿAbd Allāh, from Ibn ʿUmar ؓ, who said: "On the day of the conquest of Mecca, the Prophet ﷺ was on an ash-colored camel tending to black, and it was his she-camel al-Qaṣwāʾ, with his bow slung [across him], wearing a black turban of camel hair."
records.text_ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ أَوْرَقَ إِلَى سَوَادٍ، وَهُوَ نَاقَتُهُ الْقَصْوَاءُ، مُتَقَلِّدًا بِقَوْسِهِ، مُتَعَمِّمًا بِعِمَامَةٍ سَوْدَاءَ مِنْ وَبَرٍ»

records.text_en: From Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar ؓ, who said: "It is from the sunna that you come to the grave of the Prophet ﷺ, from the direction of the qibla, with your back to the qibla, and face the grave with your face; then you say: 'Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of God and His blessings.'"
records.text_ar: عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ: "مِنَ السُّنَّةِ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ قَبْرَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْقِبْلَةِ، وَتَجْعَلَ ظَهْرَكَ إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ، وَتَسْتَقْبِلَ الْقَبْرَ لِوَجْهِكَ، ثُمَّ تَقُولَ: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ"

matn.arabic: "مِنَ السُّنَّةِ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ قَبْرَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْقِبْلَةِ، وَتَجْعَلَ ظَهْرَكَ إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ، وَتَسْتَقْبِلَ الْقَبْرَ لِوَجْهِكَ، ثُمَّ تَقُولَ: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ"

records.text_en: From al-Qāsim, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ؓ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ taught us the sermon of need, meaning: marriage: "Indeed praise is for God; we praise Him, and seek His help, and seek His forgiveness, and seek His guidance. Whomever God guides, there is none to lead him astray, and whomever He leads astray, there is none to guide him. And we bear witness that there is no god but God, and we bear witness that Muḥammad is His servant and His Messenger. O you who believe, fear God as He should be feared, and do not die except as Muslims. And fear God, through whom you ask one another, and the wombs; indeed God is ever, over you, an Observer. O you who believe, fear God and speak a sound word; He will rectify for you your deeds and forgive you your sins; and whoever obeys God and His Messenger has certainly attained a great attainment."
records.text_ar: عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: عَلَّمَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خُطْبَةَ الْحَاجَةِ يَعْنِي: النِّكَاحَ: «إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ وَنَسْتَهْدِيهِ، مَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ، وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ، وَنَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَنَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا، اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ، وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ، وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالْأَرْحَامَ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا، يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا، اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا، يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ، وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ، وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ، فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا»

records.text_en: From Ḥammād, from Ibrāhīm, who said: An old man of the people of Medina informed me, from Zayd ibn Thābit ؓ: That he came to the Prophet ﷺ, and he said to him: "Have you married?" He said: "No." He said: "Marry, that you may attain chastity along with your chastity; and do not marry five: a shahbara, nor a nahbara, nor a lahbara, nor a haydara, nor a lafūt." Zayd said: "O Messenger of God, I do not know any of what you have said." He said: "As for the shahbara: the blue-eyed fat one; as for the nahbara: the tall, emaciated one; as for the lahbara: the old woman who has turned away [from youth]; as for the haydara: the short, blameworthy one; and as for the lafūt: the one who has a child from someone other than you." Al-Shaybānī said: "Abū Ḥanīfa laughed at this ḥadīth for a long time."
records.text_ar: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي شَيْخٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّهُ جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: "هَلْ تَزَوَّجْتَ؟ قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: "تَزَوَّجْ تَسْتَعِفَّ مَعَ عِفَّتِكَ، وَلَا تَزَوَّجَنَّ خَمْسًا: شَهْبَرَةً وَلَا نَهْبَرَةً، وَلَا لَهْبَرَةً وَلَا هَيْدَرَةً وَلَا لَفُوتًا، قَالَ زَيْدٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَا أَعْرِفُ شَيْئًا مِمَّا قُلْتَ، قَالَ: أَمَّا الشَّهْبَرَةُ: فَالزَّرْقَاءُ الْبَدِينَةُ، وَأَمَّا النَّهْبَرَةُ: فَالطَّوِيلَةُ الْمَهْزُولَةُ، وَأَمَّا اللَّهْبَرَةُ: فَالْعَجُوزُ الْمُدْبِرَةُ، وَأَمَّا الْهَيْدَرَةُ: فَالْقَصِيرَةُ الذَّمِيمَةُ، وَأَمَّا اللَّفُوتُ: فَذَاتُ الْوَلَدِ مِنْ غَيْرِكَ"، قَالَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ: ضَحِكَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ مِنْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ طَوِيلًا

matn.english: An old man of the people of Medina informed me, from Zayd ibn Thābit ؓ: That he came to the Prophet ﷺ, and he said to him: "Have you married?" He said: "No." He said: "Marry, that you may attain chastity along with your chastity; and do not marry five: a shahbara, nor a nahbara, nor a lahbara, nor a haydara, nor a lafūt." Zayd said: "O Messenger of God, I do not know any of what you have said." He said: "As for the shahbara: the blue-eyed fat one; as for the nahbara: the tall, emaciated one; as for the lahbara: the old woman who has turned away [from youth]; as for the haydara: the short, blameworthy one; and as for the lafūt: the one who has a child from someone other than you." Al-Shaybānī said: "Abū Ḥanīfa laughed at this ḥadīth for a long time."

Then he came to him again and he forbade him from her; then he came to him and he forbade him from her. Then he said: "A black woman who bears children is more beloved to me than a beautiful barren one."
records.text_ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ شَامِيٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ: أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَتَزَوَّجُ فُلَانَةً، فَنَهَاهُ عَنْهَا، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ أَيْضًا فَنَهَاهُ عَنْهَا، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ فَنَهَاهُ عَنْهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «سَوْدَاءُ وَلُودٌ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ حَسْنَاءَ عَاقِرٍ»

records.text_en:
From ʿAlqama ibn Marthad, from Ibn Burayda, who said: One day they discussed ill omen in the presence of the Messenger of God ﷺ, and he said: "Ill omen is in the house, the woman, and the horse. The ill omen of the house is that it be cramped and have bad neighbors; the ill omen of the horse is that it be unruly; and the ill omen of the woman is that she be barren."

Al-Ḥasan ibn Sufyān added: "of bad character, barren."

In a narration: "If ill omen is in anything, it is in the house, the horse, and the woman. As for the house, its ill omen is its narrowness; as for the woman, her ill omen is her bad character and the barrenness of her womb; and as for the ill omen of the horse, it is that it be unruly."
records.text_ar:
عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، قَالَ: تَذَاكَرُوا الشُّؤْمَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ: "الشُّؤْمُ فِي: الدَّارِ، وَالْمَرْأَةِ، وَالْفَرَسِ، فَشُؤْمُ الدَّارِ: أَنْ تَكُونَ ضَيِّقَةً لَهَا جِيرَانٌ سُوءٌ، وَشُؤْمُ الْفَرَسِ: أَنْ تَكُونَ جَمُوحًا، وَشُؤْمُ الْمَرْأَةِ: أَنْ تَكُونَ عَاقِرًا".

زَادَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ: «سَيِّئَةَ الْخُلُقِ عَاقِرًا».

وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «إِنْ يَكُنِ الشُّؤْمُ فِي شَيْءٍ، فَفِي الدَّارِ وَالْفَرَسِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ، فَأَمَّا الدَّارُ، فَشُؤْمُهَا ضِيقُهَا، وَأَمَّا الْمَرْأَةُ، فَشُؤْمُهَا سُوءُ خُلُقِهَا وَعُقْرُ رَحِمَهَا، وَأَمَّا شُؤْمُ الْفَرَسِ، فَأَنْ يَكُونَ جَمُوحًا»

records.text_en: From Shaybān, from Yaḥyā, from Abū Hurayra ؓ, who said: When the Messenger of God ﷺ wanted to marry off one of his daughters, he would say: "So-and-so is mentioning so-and-so," then he would marry her off.
